task.ques: Calculate (1+0.1*i)^8 + (1−0.2*i)^8  where i is a complex number.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: (1 + 0.1i)^8 + (1 − 0.2i)^8 = 0.71718257 − 0.4252584i.
Evidence: WolframAlpha interprets i as the imaginary unit and displays “0.71718257 - 0.4252584 i” under Result with “Fewer digits” selected. Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=%281%2B0.1*i%29%5E8+%2B+%281-0.2*i%29%5E8 (accessed October 27, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
